envVars.R2_ACCOUNT_ID: Cloudflare account id, from the dashboard URL or `wrangler whoami`. One of four optional values that together let this provider hand a browser a presigned URL. Leave them unset and reads and writes still work through the R2 binding — every upload and download just streams through the Worker's proxy route instead.
envVars.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: Access key id of an R2 API token with Object Read & Write on the bucket, from R2 → Manage API tokens. The Worker binding is a different credential and cannot sign a URL, which is why this exists. Set it in `.dev.vars` locally and with `wrangler secret put R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` in production.
envVars.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: Secret access key shown once when the R2 API token is created. A secret: never in wrangler.jsonc, never in a repo. `wrangler secret put R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` in production.
envVars.R2_BUCKET_NAME: Name of the bucket the S3-compatible URL addresses, e.g. `app-storage`. It must be the bucket the `BUCKET` binding points at, or a presigned link will read and write a different bucket than the binding does.
